new_value: seven empty ledgers (all seven rotation entries carry an empty dependency ledger; i.e. the resolver reports zero dependency edges for Aatrox)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

independent_computation.question_restated: Does Aatrox's rotation, as described by the cached wiki text, contain zero dependency edges? An all-empty ledger asserts that no cast in the rotation depends on any other cast, buff, hit-count or prior damage.
independent_computation.answer: No. The cached wiki text yields at least six distinct, load-bearing dependency edges, five of which are already carried as non-empty `relations` in the cached atom decomposition. The correct value is a NON-EMPTY dependency ledger.

edges_derived_from_cache.edge: R (World Ender) -> Q1/Q2/Q3, W, P, basic attacks  [buff-before-damage]
edges_derived_from_cache.source: data/champions.json Aatrox.abilities.R effects[2]: 'During World Ender, Aatrox gains bonus attack damage ...' leveling 'Bonus Attack Damage' = [20, 30, 40] units ['% AD']; effects[0]: 'unleashes his true form for 10 seconds'.
edges_derived_from_cache.why_load_bearing: Every Aatrox damage row is AD-scaling (Q first cast 60-90% AD, third cast 90-135% AD, third sweetspot 236.25% AD at rank 5; W 40% AD). At R rank 3 the AD term is multiplied by 1.40. Worked example, Q third-cast sweetspot at rank 5: 183.75 + 236.25% AD without R, versus 183.75 + 330.75% AD with R first (236.25 x 1.4 = 330.75). Cast order R-then-Q vs Q-then-R changes the packet by +40% of its AD component. An empty ledger cannot express this ordering constraint.
edges_derived_from_cache.corroboration: data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json Aatrox: 'R World Ender modeled as %total-AD stat buff'. data/worklists/f2-task.md line 10 names this exact edge as a required resolver signal: 'buffs first (Aatrox R AD amp before damage, ...)'.

edges_derived_from_cache.edge: Q1 -> Q2 -> Q3  [intra-ability cast chain, ordering + 1s gate + 4s expiry]
edges_derived_from_cache.source: data/champions.json Aatrox.abilities.Q effects[0]: 'Aatrox can activate The Darkin Blade three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 1-second static cooldown between casts. If Aatrox does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.' effects[1]: 'Each subsequent cast gains 25% more damage.'
edges_derived_from_cache.arithmetic_check: Rank-5 rows confirm the chain multipliers exactly: First 70 + 90% AD, Second 87.5 + 112.5% AD (87.5/70 = 1.25, 112.5/90 = 1.25), Third 105 + 135% AD (105/70 = 1.50, 135/90 = 1.50). Sweetspot rows are 1.75x their base cast (122.5/70 = 1.75, 157.5/90 = 1.75), matching 'Enemies hit within a Sweetspot ... take 75% bonus damage'.
edges_derived_from_cache.why_load_bearing: The third cast is the largest packet and is only reachable after the first two; the 1s inter-cast gate and 4s recast window are hard scheduling dependencies. Zero edges asserts Q3 is independently castable.

edges_derived_from_cache.edge: every ability hit / on-hit auto -> P (Deathbringer Stance) cooldown  [hit-count dependency]
edges_derived_from_cache.source: data/champions.json Aatrox.abilities.P effects[1]: 'Whenever Aatrox hits at least one enemy champion or large monster with a basic attack on-hit or an ability, Deathbringer Stance's current cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds, doubled to 4 if he hits with the Sweetspot of The Darkin Blade.' P cooldown modifier values run 22.0 at level 1 to 10.0 at level 18, affectedByCdr false.
edges_derived_from_cache.arithmetic_check: At level 18 the P cooldown is 10.0s. A three-cast Q rotation landing sweetspots removes 3 x 4 = 12s >= 10.0s, so P is fully reset by one Q rotation; the same rotation landing no sweetspots removes 3 x 2 = 6s, leaving 4.0s. The number of P procs in the fight window is therefore a strict function of the cast schedule and its sweetspot flags.
edges_derived_from_cache.why_load_bearing: P damage is 4%-10% (by level) of target max health (rank rows 4.0 ... 10.0 '%'), so a proc-count difference is a first-order damage difference. An empty ledger asserts P's cadence is independent of the rotation.

edges_derived_from_cache.edge: W first hit -> W tether second hit (delayed, 1.5s)
edges_derived_from_cache.source: data/champions.json Aatrox.abilities.W effects[0] 'Physical Damage' [30,40,50,60,70] + 40% AD; effects[1] 'a tether is formed ... for 1.5 seconds'; effects[2] 'If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same physical damage again', 'Total Damage' [60,80,100,120,140] + 80% AD.
edges_derived_from_cache.arithmetic_check: 140/70 = 2.0 and 80/40 = 2.0 — the Total row is exactly twice the initial row, confirming the second instance is conditional on and identical to the first.
edges_derived_from_cache.why_load_bearing: The second packet exists only as a consequence of the first and only after a 1.5s delay; that is a dependency edge with a timing attribute.

edges_derived_from_cache.edge: damage dealt -> E (Umbral Dash) passive heal; R -> that heal's magnitude
edges_derived_from_cache.source: data/champions.json Aatrox.abilities.E effects[0]: 'Aatrox heals for 16% (+ 1.1% per 100 bonus health) of non-persistent post-mitigation damage he deals against enemy champions.' Aatrox.abilities.R effects[2] leveling 'Increased Healing' [50, 75, 100] units ['%'].
edges_derived_from_cache.why_load_bearing: The heal ledger is a function of the damage ledger (post-mitigation, champion-only), and R multiplies it by 1.5/1.75/2.0. Two chained dependencies. data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json confirms the engine models exactly this: 'E1 added Deathbringer Stance passive heal + E 16%+1.1%/100 bHP heal + R healing-amp rule ... verified in /api/calculate (self-heal 313.7 at level 18, no items)'.

edges_derived_from_cache.edge: E (Umbral Dash) -> basic-attack cadence [attack reset]; E interleaves inside other casts
edges_derived_from_cache.source: data/champions.json Aatrox.abilities.E effects[2]: 'Umbral Dash resets Aatrox's basic attack timer and can be cast during his other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.' Aatrox.abilities.Q notes cast-time table: 'Abilities: Umbral Dash can be cast. Other abilities are disabled.'
edges_derived_from_cache.corroboration: data/atoms/aatrox.atoms.json, atom 'interaction.attack-reset' (behavior AatroxE) carries relations ['stats.attack-speed', 'damage.basic-attack'] — the cached atomization already records this exact edge.

cached_atom_relations_contradicting_an_e: NOTE: 5 of Aatrox's 25 cached atoms carry non-empty `relations`. Any dependency ledger derived from the atomized data must be non-empty; a ledger derived from the wiki prose is non-empty for the six independent reasons above.
independent_computation.correct_value: A non-empty dependency ledger. Minimum required content, one edge per row: (E1) R -> all AD-scaling rows [buff-first]; (E2) Q1 -> Q2 -> Q3 [cast chain, 1s gate, 4s expiry, 1.00/1.25/1.50 damage multipliers]; (E3) each ability/auto hit -> P cooldown [-2s, -4s on Q sweetspot]; (E4) W hit -> W tether hit [+1.5s, same packet]; (E5) damage dealt -> E passive heal, amplified by R; (E6) E -> basic-attack timer reset / intra-cast interleave. Seven empty ledgers is the assertion that none of these exist.
independent_computation.why_the_narrow_reading_does_not_rescue_t: One could argue Aatrox has no classic 'setup/consume' combo (no Varus Blight, no Brand Blaze) and that an empty ledger is therefore defensible. That defence fails on the project's own stated resolver contract: data/worklists/f2-task.md line 10 lists four dependency signals the resolver must encode — (a) per-rank DPS, (b) setup/consume, (c) cooldown gating, (d) buffs first — and names Aatrox under (d) verbatim ('Aatrox R AD amp before damage'). Aatrox also satisfies (c) via the Q 1s inter-cast gate / 4s expiry and the P hit-driven cooldown. Under either the wiki text or the resolver's own declared signal set, the ledger must be non-empty.
independent_computation.verdict_reasoning: The old value (<absent>) is not a computable value of a field that now exists and records nothing. The new value (seven empty ledgers) makes a positive, checkable claim — 'this rotation has no dependencies' — that the cached wiki text and the cached atom relations both refute. Neither the old nor the new value equals the independently computed correct value, so the verdict is both_wrong. The actionable half is the new value: seven empty ledgers is a false negative from the resolver, not a neutral placeholder.

caveats: This oracle worked only from the permitted export (data/ and docs/math-foundations.md). The emitting code and the exact JSON schema of the `dependencies` ledger were not read, so the shape of the correct value (list-of-edges vs keyed ledger) is stated semantically, not as a literal JSON blob.
The count 'seven' was not independently reproducible from data/ alone; the finding does not depend on it. Whatever the seven entries are, all-empty is refuted by the six edges above.
docs/math-foundations.md documents the shared-timeline cast scheduler (Section 1.1) but contains no 'dependencies' term; it therefore cannot license an empty ledger either.
